experience.title: Experience

experience.heynow_desc: Uruguayan AI company leading in artificial intelligence solutions with over 250 clients in Latin America, the Caribbean, North America, and Europe. I joined as Front-End Architect, leading the product redesign and scaling the front-end architecture. Then I evolved to the Full Stack AI Developer role, expanding my scope to the complete development of the platforms, including agent to agent (A2A) communication infrastructure.
experience.revenue_desc: B2B company specialized in revenue strategies and commercial growth. Development of digital platforms for managing and optimizing B2B commercial processes.
experience.liberasoft_desc: Argentine company with over 20 years of experience developing a modular cloud ERP. My 7 years reflect a continuous evolution: from building interfaces with Angular and PrimeNG, to leading the frontend architecture, expanding to Full Stack with Node.js, MySQL and MongoDB, and finally integrating AI into the product with n8n, Python and RAG for generative AI functionalities.
